references.text: Parallel law regarding the piercing of a slave's ear who chooses to remain with their master permanently, performed at the doorpost.
Laws concerning Hebrew slaves and their treatment, including provisions for release and permanent service.
The full legal text regarding Hebrew slaves, their release after six years, and the option to choose permanent service.
The psalm mentions that God has opened ears, which may be linked to the piercing of a slave's ear as a sign of obedience and devotion.
The Lord's servant has their ears opened by God, a spiritual parallel to the pierced ear of a slave as a sign of willing service.
